Complies with ATX12V V3.1 & EPS12V V2.92
450V, 105°C capacitors for a long product life cycle
Built for the demanding power requirements of tomorrow, these PSUs offer maximum total power excursion support as per ATX 3.1, ensuring peak performance with future hardware upgrades.
Some changes in the new spec. from ATX3.0 to ATX3.1, FSP follows Intel recommended criteria to keep it on the latest version and focus on user benefits.
The HYPER K PRO series, 80 PLUS
230V EU Standard certified, saves energy through its high efficiency up to 82% and excesses the standard through its high efficiency up to 85%.

The bulk capacitor inside serves to support working under an extremely harsh environment, such as with high temperatures, peak voltage fluctuations. It stabilizes the performance for high reliability that your system can count on.
With a 12V SR circuit and the DC to DC module design, the HYPER K PRO series ensure you outstanding conversion efficiency and provides stable output voltage.
